definitions.explanation: The freezing compartment of a refrigerator, or a standalone freezer unit. Used for storing frozen food and making ice.

examples.japanese: {冷凍室|れいとうしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧おいて。
{冷凍室|れいとうしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧いっぱいになった。
⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{冷凍室|れいとうしつ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{解凍|かいとう}→解凍：19085_kaitou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take the meat out of the freezer and defrost it.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{冷凍|れいとう}→冷凍：11730_reitou⟧ (freezing) and ⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (room, compartment). Refers to either the freezer section of a household refrigerator or a commercial/industrial freezer room.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冷凍室|れいとうしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put in the freezer
- {冷凍室|れいとうしつ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to take out of the freezer
- {冷凍室|れいとうしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧: freezer temperature
- {冷凍室|れいとうしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{整理|せいり}→整理：03297_seiri⟧: organizing the freezer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{冷凍庫|れいとうこ}→冷凍庫：14721_reitouko⟧: freezer — essentially the same meaning; ⟦{冷凍庫|れいとうこ}→冷凍庫：14721_reitouko⟧ is more common in everyday speech for standalone freezers
- {冷蔵室|れいぞうしつ}: refrigerator compartment — the chilled (not frozen) section of a fridge
- ⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧: refrigerator — the entire appliance including both fridge and freezer sections
